label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.46… supports Rival: some mover other than the moved…
note: Reading B of q.46 a.2 ad 7 makes 'inquantum' (relevance to the causing), not time, the criterion of an accidental cause; on that criterion a mover now moved in an irrelevant respect is no per se link, as the rival says. Evidence for the rival's possibility, not a statement of it.
